requirements: size may be 0; then NULL is returned.

functions.description: Resizes a previous allocation from this allocator. If originalPtr is NULL, behaves like Malloc(newSize). If newSize == 0, returns NULL and does not free. Handler must implement the Handler concept methods used by the input (Null, Bool, Int/Uint/Int64/Uint64/Double, RawNumber if numbers-as-strings, String, StartObject/Key/EndObject, StartArray/EndArray) and return true to continue; returning false causes termination with kParseErrorTermination.
If kParseInsituFlag is set, the input must be mutable and the stream must support in-situ operations (PutBegin/PutEnd); the source buffer may be modified (e.g., null-terminating strings).
If kParseStopWhenDoneFlag is not set, extra non-whitespace after a complete root value triggers kParseErrorDocumentRootNotSingular.

functions.name: GenericUri::GenericUri

functions.description: Constructs a URI by parsing the provided character buffer of length len into scheme, authority, path, query, and fragment, optionally using the provided allocator.

len must be the exact number of characters to parse; parsing reads only len characters.
If allocator is non-null, it must remain valid for the lifetime of the GenericUri or until a different allocator is assigned/created internally.
Parsing follows RFC 3986 component extraction and normalizes absolute paths by removing dot segments.
